quality_proxy: measured sampled API-visible evidence RGB PSNR dB / 10, without upper clipping
learning_method: Kev supervised imitation of one-step counterfactual replay argmax at states collected by continuous behavior-policy rollouts; not online RL or a long-horizon oracle.
dataset_role: Development integration on a synthetic playlist of the same ten clips, not contiguous source-video chunks. Network acquisition groups are disjoint. No semantic QA correctness or unseen-video generalization claim. Original ROI flags retained.
